# fixture-multi

A fixture repo whose catalog declares two Components, an API and a Resource,
the shape of the `wac` repo.

## The one thing to understand

One repo, two catalog Components.

## Commands

```sh
kubectl get pods -A
```

## Layout

- Nothing but the catalog.

## Invariants

- Nothing here is real.

## Boundaries

- Do not edit the fixture during a test; copy it first.
